title: Reading the output of print
observableEvidence: Reads a short listing of print lines with literal values from top to bottom and types its exact output: one output line per print, in order, with text shown without its quotes.
Writes several comma-separated values on one output line with a single space between them, and writes whole numbers, decimal numbers and True or False exactly as the program shows them.
masteryCheckRule: Practice evidence only: the typed output must exactly match the authored output (evaluator python-output-1). PY6-P1-01 is a program-internal objective code, not an external standard. Does not establish mastery of programming.
